jobs.title: Credit Analyst, Emerging Market Corporate Debt
jobs.description:
About Ninety One:

Ninety One is an independent, active global asset manager with $226.5 billion* of assets under management.

Established in South Africa in 1991, as Investec Asset Management, the firm started offering domestic investments in an emerging market. In 2020, almost three decades of organic growth later, the firm demerged from Investec Group and became Ninety One.

Our distinctive capabilities sit within differentiated fixed income and credit as well as specialist equities, and we have a unique perspective and approach to investment opportunities presented by emerging markets and the energy transition.

About our EM Corporate Debt team:

Ninety One’s Emerging Market Corporate Debt team is a global investment capability focused on delivering differentiated credit outcomes across the EM universe. With a strong track record and deep local knowledge, the team blends rigorous bottom-up credit research with top-down market insights to identify compelling investment opportunities.

This role is based in Saudi Arabia and provides a unique opportunity to work closely with the Chief Investment Officer of Ninety One’s Saudi entity, while being an integrated part of the global Emerging Market Corporate Credit platform. The team operates in a collaborative and intellectually curious environment, with a strong focus on innovation, client outcomes, and continuous learning. We are looking for individuals to grow and contribute to the build out of the local entity and dedicated regional strategies over time.

As an Analyst, you will:

Conduct independent, bottom-up credit research on financial institutions and corporates across Saudi Arabia and other emerging markets
Generate differentiated investment ideas with the objective of outperforming benchmarks
Formulate and communicate clear investment recommendations to portfolio managers
Contribute to top-down analysis to support country, sector, and risk positioning
Monitor and evaluate the performance of issuers and adjust recommendations as needed
Analyse financial statements, credit metrics, and qualitative factors to assess issuer fundamentals and sustainability
Incorporate macroeconomic and market insights into investment analysis
Assist in the development and enhancement of proprietary research tools and databases
Prepare written research, internal and client reporting, and support investment presentations
Participate in investment meetings and contribute to ongoing improvement across research processes

You should consider applying if you have:

4+ years of experience in fixed income, credit research, or investment analysis, ideally gained within asset management, investment banking, or a credit rating agency
A strong understanding of financial institutions and corporate credit fundamentals
Familiarity with emerging markets, with knowledge of Saudi Arabia and/or the GCC region
A degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field; progress toward or completion of the CFA qualification is advantageous
Excellent analytical and communication skills, with strong attention to detail
Intellectual curiosity and a desire to continuously improve
Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are required

Some of the attributes we look for in a person are:

A strong belief in doing the right thing
Intellectual curiosity
High conviction and be comfortable sharing opinions
Ability to analyse, interpret and assimilate information
A curiosity about technology and its potential to drive innovation

Analyst

Investment Management and Financial Services

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst Gradiant Industries - L.L.C - S.P.C. Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates 8/25/26 Finance

Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at gradiant.com.

Role Overview

The Financial Analyst will provide comprehensive financial analysis, reporting and business partnering support to the Regional Finance Manager across the Middle East region. The role will support regional consolidation, management reporting, budgeting and forecasting, financial analysis, working capital, cash flow and operational business partnering, while also providing analytical support for strategic finance projects.

The role will work closely with Finance, Operations, Commercial and Corporate functions to translate financial data into meaningful insights, identify risks and opportunities, and support informed business decisions.

The position will also support the Regional Finance Manager on strategic projects including investments, capital expenditure, ADIO grants, due diligence, financial projections, goodwill and investment impairment assessments, and other corporate initiatives.

Responsibilities

Regional Reporting & Consolidation
Support monthly regional consolidation and management reporting across multiple entities.
Prepare and analyze consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow information.
Perform intercompany reconciliations and investigate consolidation differences.
Analyze actual results against budget, forecast and prior periods.
Prepare monthly reporting packs, KPI analysis and management commentary.
Investigate significant variances and provide clear explanations and recommendations.
Support Group Finance, audit and year-end reporting requirements.
FP&A & Financial Analysis
Support annual budgeting, forecasting and rolling financial projections.
Analyze revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, working capital and cash flow.
Develop financial models, forecasts and scenario analysis to support management decisions.
Monitor business performance against budgets and forecasts and identify key trends and risks.
Prepare financial projections and sensitivity analysis for business planning and strategic initiatives.
Develop and maintain financial dashboards, KPIs and analytical tools.
Business Partnering with Operations
Act as a finance business partner to Operations and project teams.
Develop a strong understanding of operational and project drivers affecting revenue, costs, margins and cash flow.
Work with Operations to analyze project performance, profitability, cost overruns and margin risks.
Provide financial insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve profitability and financial performance.
Support business cases, project evaluations and commercial decisions.
Working Capital & Cash Flow
Monitor and analyze key working capital metrics including DSO, DPO, inventory and overdue receivables.
Support regional cash flow forecasting and liquidity analysis.
Identify working capital risks and opportunities and work with Operations and Commercial teams on improvement initiatives.
Analyze cash conversion and project-related cash flow requirements.
Strategic Finance & Special Projects

Provide analytical and financial support to the Regional Finance Manager on regional and corporate strategic initiatives, including:

Investment and capital expenditure analysis.
New business, expansion and manufacturing investment projects.
Preparation of business cases, financial models and investment projections.
ADIO grant-related activities, including claims tracking, reporting, reconciliations, eligible expenditure analysis and audit/AUP support.
Financial due diligence for potential investments, acquisitions, partnerships and other strategic transactions.
Analysis of historical financial performance, working capital, cash flow and key financial risks as part of due diligence.
Goodwill and investment impairment assessments, including financial projections, cash flow forecasts, valuation assumptions and sensitivity analysis.
Support for investment valuation and financial modelling.
Scenario analysis for strategic decisions, funding requirements and major investments.
Other regional transformation, finance and ad hoc projects.
Regional Finance Team Support & Ad Hoc Activities
Provide support to the Regional Finance Team on additional activities and priorities as required from time to time.
Provide temporary coverage or assistance for key finance activities when team members are on annual leave, sick leave or otherwise unavailable, helping to ensure continuity of critical regional finance processes.
Assist Finance Managers and team members with reporting, analysis, reconciliations and other finance deliverables during peak periods.
Support urgent or time-sensitive regional finance requirements as directed by the Regional Finance Manager.
Undertake ad hoc financial analysis, reporting, projects and other assignments that may arise based on business requirements.
Demonstrate flexibility in supporting changing priorities while maintaining appropriate focus on core responsibilities.
Process Improvement & Reporting Automation
Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy and automation of regional reporting.
Develop and enhance Excel-based financial models, dashboards and reporting tools.
Support improvements to SAP and other ERP/reporting systems.
Improve data quality, reporting consistency and standardization across entities.
Automate recurring analysis and reporting where practical.

Key Deliverables

The Financial Analyst Will Be Expected To Support

Accurate and timely monthly regional consolidation and reporting.
High-quality variance analysis and management insights.
Budgeting, forecasting and financial projections.
Revenue, margin and project profitability analysis.
Working capital and cash flow analysis.
Operational and commercial business partnering.
ADIO grant financial reporting and supporting analysis.
Investment, due diligence and strategic project analysis.
Goodwill and investment impairment projections and supporting models.
Financial models, dashboards and management presentations.
Continuity of key Finance activities during team absences and peak workload periods.
Continuous improvement and automation of finance processes.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or related discipline.
Professional qualification such as CPA, CMA, ACCA or CIMA is an advantage.
3–6 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, management reporting, commercial finance or audit.
Experience working with multiple entities or regional operations is preferred.
Experience in project-based, engineering, manufacturing, technology, infrastructure or similar industries is advantageous.
Experience with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or other ERP systems preferred.
Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Commercial and business-oriented mindset.
Proactive, adaptable and results-focused.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Comfortable working with Finance and Operations stakeholders.
Ability to challenge assumptions constructively.
Collaborative and solutions-oriented.
Flexible and willing to support the broader Finance Team when business requirements change.
Strong commitment to continuous improvement.

Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.
